prd: PRD-16 Role Dashboards, Reports & Early-Warning Insights (SCH-016)

functionalRequirements.description: /dashboard renders AdminDashboard, TeacherDashboard or StudentDashboard by role; PARENT is redirected to the child overview (/my-children, existing PRD-15 redirect kept).

Each dashboard widget is an independent server component wrapped in Suspense with an MUI Skeleton fallback and an error boundary showing 'This widget could not load — Retry' without breaking the rest of the page.
Greeting header shows 'Good morning/afternoon/evening, <first name>' by school-timezone time of day, plus today's date and the current term name.
Teacher 'Today's classes' widget: today's timetable with Now/Next badges, per-class attendance status (taken / not taken) with a 'Take attendance' action and a link to the course.
Teacher 'To grade' widget: count plus top 5 (oldest first) submitted-but-ungraded assignment submissions and quiz attempts needing grading across the teacher's courses, with links.
Teacher 'Upcoming deadlines' widget: assignments and quizzes in the teacher's courses due in the next 7 days, each with its submission rate.
Teacher 'At-risk students' widget: top 5 at-risk students among the teacher's accessible students with reasons and a link to /insights/at-risk.
Teacher 'Messages & announcements' widget: unread message count (PRD-13) and latest 3 announcements (PRD-12).
functionalRequirements.source: PRD-16 FR-2.5 (announcement data source absent in workspace — see clarificationLog)

functionalRequirements.description: Teacher 'Quick actions' widget: New assignment, New announcement, Take attendance, New quiz links.
Student 'Today' widget: today's schedule with Now/Next badges, or a holiday message on non-school days.
Student 'Due soon' widget: assignments and open quizzes due in the next 7 days; overdue (missing) items listed first and highlighted in red.
Student 'Recent grades' widget: last 5 grades with course and percent.
Student 'My courses' widget: course cards with current percent and letter (consistent with the Grades tab), PRD-08 content progress bar and next-lesson link.
Student 'Announcements' widget: latest 3 unread announcements.
functionalRequirements.source: PRD-16 FR-3.5 (announcement data source absent in workspace — see clarificationLog)

functionalRequirements.description: Student 'Attendance this term' widget: term attendance rate shown with a small MUI X Gauge.

Admin KPI row of StatCards: active students, active teachers, today's attendance rate with delta vs. same weekday last week, registers missing today, open safeguarding reports (visible to safeguarding leads only), pending absence notes.
Admin 'Attendance trend': MUI X LineChart of daily school-wide attendance rate over the last 30 school days with SchoolSettings.attendanceAlertThreshold as a reference line.
Admin 'Enrollment by grade level': MUI X BarChart of active students per grade level, stacked by gender.
Admin 'Grade distribution': MUI X BarChart histogram of current-term course percentages across all students in 10 % buckets, with average and median.
Admin 'At-risk summary': counts by risk level (High / Medium) and by reason, with link to the full list.
Admin 'Upcoming events': next 5 school events from PRD-14 CalendarEvent.
functionalRequirements.source: PRD-16 FR-4.6 (CalendarEvent model exists but no calendar service/API — see clarificationLog)

functionalRequirements.description: Admin 'Recent activity': last 10 AuditLog entries with action types user.*, report_card.*, settings.*.

Expensive aggregates (admin KPIs, trends, distributions, risk scores) are computed in src/server/dashboards/insights.ts and cached with Next.js unstable_cache keyed by role scope: 15-minute revalidate, 60 minutes for at-risk.
Each cached widget shows 'Updated N min ago'; admins get a 'Refresh' button calling POST /api/dashboard/refresh that revalidates the cache tags (and triggers risk recompute).

src/server/dashboards/risk.ts computes three signals per ACTIVE student in the current term: Attendance (< school threshold, default 90 % → Medium; < 80 % → High); Grades (any course < 60 % → Medium; ≥2 courses < 60 % or any < 50 % → High); Missing work (3–4 missing assignments in last 30 days → Medium; ≥5 → High).
Overall risk level = High if any signal is High or two signals are Medium; Medium if exactly one signal is Medium; otherwise none.

Add Prisma model StudentRiskSnapshot { studentId, termId, level, reasons Json, computedAt } (one row per student per term, upserted) with migration; refreshed by the existing maintenance run (internal dispatch cron) at most once per hour and on admin Refresh.
Snapshot history sufficient to drive a trend arrow vs. the previous snapshot and a 'short history' on the student Insights tab, despite one upserted row per student per term.
functionalRequirements.source: PRD-16 FR-6.3 vs FR-6.4/FR-6.5 (conflict — see clarificationLog)

functionalRequirements.description: Page /insights/at-risk scoped ADMIN: all students; TEACHER: students they teach plus their homeroom section; table with student, section, level badge, reason chips ('Attendance 78 %', '2 courses < 60 %', '6 missing'), trend arrow, and actions (open student, message parents).
At-risk list filters (level, reason, grade level, section) and formula-injection-safe CSV export matching the filtered table.
Register student tab 'Insights' in src/config/student-tabs.ts (ADMIN/TEACHER) showing current signal values and a short snapshot history.
Risk level change from none/Medium to High notifies the student's homeroom teacher via notify() with new type 'insights.student_high_risk' (default email true), at most once per student per 14 days.

Reports centre at /admin/reports (ADMIN) with an academic-year and term selector at the top; every report has filters, a chart, a data table and formula-injection-safe CSV export (reuse PRD-03 CSV helper src/server/csv.ts).
Enrollment report: students by grade level, section and gender; new enrollments and archives by month.
Attendance report: rate by grade level / section / course for a date range, daily trend, top 20 lowest students — reusing the PRD-07 attendance service; CSV rows match the on-screen table.
Academic performance report: average percent and letter distribution by course and by subject for a term; comparison between sections of the same grade for the same subject.
Assignment completion report: on-time / late / missing rates by course and by teacher for a date range.

Engagement report: lesson completion rate by course (PRD-08 LessonProgress), announcement read rate (PRD-12), distinct parents signed in during last 7/30 days from User.lastLoginAt and audit 'auth.login.success'.
functionalRequirements.source: PRD-16 FR-7.5 (announcement read data absent — see clarificationLog)

functionalRequirements.description: Teacher workload report: per teacher — courses, students taught, weekly periods (PRD-06 TimetableSlot), grading backlog.
Navigation (src/config/navigation.ts): 'Dashboard' stays first for all roles; ADMIN adds 'Reports' and 'At-risk students'; TEACHER adds 'At-risk students'.
API: GET /api/dashboard/teacher (TEACHER), GET /api/dashboard/student (STUDENT), GET /api/dashboard/admin (ADMIN) return widget data; POST /api/dashboard/refresh (ADMIN) revalidates cache tags.
API: GET /api/insights/at-risk?level=&reason=&sectionId=&page= (ADMIN, TEACHER scoped; ?format=csv); filters can never widen a teacher's scope beyond accessible students.
API: GET /api/students/:id/insights (ADMIN, TEACHER of the student).
API: GET /api/reports/:reportKey (ADMIN) with reportKey ∈ enrollment, attendance, performance, completion, engagement, workload and ?format=csv; unknown key → 404.

Add 'npm run seed:large' script: 600 students across Grades 6–8 (8 sections), 40 teachers, full timetables, 60 school days of attendance, assignments and grades, deterministic with a fixed random seed; default seed stays small.
Default seed guarantees at least 3 students at each risk level (High, Medium, none).

nonFunctionalRequirements.description: Performance: with seed:large data (600 students, 40 teachers, one year), every dashboard renders first content < 1.5 s and each report < 3 s.

Accessibility: every chart has a visually hidden data table or aria-label summary (e.g. 'Attendance trend: 94.2 % average, lowest 88.1 % on 3 Oct'); colours meet 3:1 contrast and use patterns/labels where colour alone conveys meaning; each role dashboard passes an axe scan.

Privacy: teacher dashboards, risk lists and student insights include only students from getAccessibleStudentIds (src/server/auth/student-access.ts); enforced server-side in every handler and server page.
nonFunctionalRequirements.source: PRD-16 NFR-3; Platform Context 'Code layout' (requireRole); Acceptance Criterion 6

nonFunctionalRequirements.description: UI component rule: every visible element uses @mui/material, @mui/icons-material or MUI X (x-charts LineChart/BarChart/Gauge, x-data-grid via shared DataTable, x-date-pickers); no banned libraries (Tailwind, shadcn, Recharts, etc.); no hand-styled raw HTML where an MUI component exists; styling only via theme/sx/styled().
nonFunctionalRequirements.source: PRD-16 Platform Context 'UI component rule' items 1, 3, 5, 6

nonFunctionalRequirements.description: Every MUI component used is looked up through the mui-mcp server (useMuiDocs + fetchDocs) for the installed version (9.5.0) before use; MCP unavailability is reported as a blocker; QA verifies no banned imports and every MUI import resolves to a documented component.
nonFunctionalRequirements.source: PRD-16 Platform Context 'UI component rule' items 2, 6

nonFunctionalRequirements.description: Conventions: thin route handlers (Zod parse → service → JSON), Zod schemas in src/lib/validators/<feature>.ts, standard success/list/error response shapes and error codes, pagination ?page/?pageSize (max 100), services in feature subdirectory src/server/dashboards/ and src/server/reports/, cuid IDs with createdAt/updatedAt.
nonFunctionalRequirements.source: PRD-16 Platform Context 'Code layout and conventions'

nonFunctionalRequirements.description: All date rules (today, time-of-day greeting, last 30 days, school days, 7-day windows) use SchoolSettings.timezone; timestamps stored UTC.

Brownfield: reuse existing models, services and components (StatCard, DataTable, LoadingSkeleton, PageHeader, Toast/useToast, csv.ts, attendance-service, gradebook, notify(), audit()); never re-scaffold, rename routes/models or duplicate helpers.
nonFunctionalRequirements.source: PRD-16 Platform Context intro; FR-7.2 'reuses PRD-07 service'

nonFunctionalRequirements.description: Tests: unit tests for every risk boundary (90/80 %, 60/50 %, 3/5 missing, Medium+Medium → High); integration tests of report queries against seeded data with known totals and of cache revalidation; Playwright e2e per role dashboard with axe scan.
Keep npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test passing; no console.log (use src/lib/logger.ts).
nonFunctionalRequirements.source: PRD-16 Platform Context 'Assumptions and constraints' and 'Code layout'

nonFunctionalRequirements.description: Scope guard: no custom drag-and-drop dashboard layouts, no ML risk models (rule-based only), no scheduled report emails; do not modify behaviour owned by PRD-17/18.
nonFunctionalRequirements.source: PRD-16 Out of Scope; Platform Context 'Constraints'

nonFunctionalRequirements.description: Freshness: at-risk data refreshed at least hourly (cache ≤ 60 min, maintenance recompute at most once/hour).

brownfieldObservations: Placeholder src/app/(app)/dashboard/page.tsx exists; already redirects PARENT to /my-children (PRD-15 FR-8) — keep that behaviour.
Shared components live under src/components/<Name>/ (StatCard, DataTable, LoadingSkeleton, PageHeader, EmptyState, Toast), not src/components/shared/.
SchoolSettings.attendanceAlertThreshold (default 90) exists; use it as the attendance risk threshold and trend reference line.
User.lastLoginAt and Gender enum (FEMALE, MALE, OTHER, UNDISCLOSED) exist; safeguardingLead flag and safeguarding reports API exist (src/server/messaging/access.ts).
No Announcement model in prisma/schema.prisma (PRD-12 only has src/server/announcements/audience.ts).
CalendarEvent/EventAudience models exist but there is no calendar service or API (PRD-14 dev phase previously failed).
No 'missing' column: SubmissionStatus is SUBMITTED|RETURNED; missing = published assignment past due with no submission and no GradeExemption (pattern in src/server/assignments/reminders.ts).
Maintenance passes run from the internal dispatch cron at src/app/api/internal/email/dispatch/route.ts — the hourly risk recompute hooks in there.
No unstable_cache usage exists yet; no npm seed:large script yet.

questions: PRD-12 Announcement model is absent. Should the teacher/student Announcements widgets and the engagement 'announcement read rate' render an empty state, or is PRD-12 expected to be repaired first?
PRD-14 has no calendar service/API. May the admin 'Upcoming events' widget query the existing CalendarEvent model directly (school-wide, non-recurring expansion only)?

StudentRiskSnapshot is 'one row per student per term, upserted', yet the list needs a trend arrow vs. the previous snapshot and the Insights tab needs a short history. Store previousLevel + a capped history array in the row, or add a separate history table?
How is 'missing' counted for the risk signal: published assignments due in the last 30 days with no submission and no exemption (NO_SUBMISSION type excluded)?
Is a student with no attendance records / no graded courses in the term treated as 'no signal' (not at risk)?
Which teacher students count as 'their students' for dashboards and notifications: enrolled in courses they teach plus their homeroom section (i.e. getAccessibleStudentIds)?
unresolved: Announcement data source for FR-8, FR-14, FR-38 — default: render EmptyState / omit the metric with 'Announcements not available' and record as dependency gap; Architect to confirm.
Upcoming events source for FR-21 — default: query CalendarEvent directly via a small read function in the dashboards service.
Snapshot history design for FR-28 — default: keep unique (studentId, termId) and store previousLevel plus a capped history array in reasons/extra Json; Architect to decide.
Missing-work definition — default: reuse the reminders.ts definition (published, due within last 30 days, no submission, not exempt, submissionType != NO_SUBMISSION).
No interactive user available; round 1 defaults carried forward. Aggregate confidence 91 % ≥ 80 % threshold, so no further rounds required.
